He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State Seminoles]]. ==College career== [[File:Mfiondu Kabengele (cropped).jpg|150px|thumb|left|Kabengele with Florida State]] Kabengele came to Florida State as an unheralded recruit and [[redshirt (college sports)|redshirted]] his freshman season. As a redshirt freshman, he played an important role on a team that reached the Elite Eight, averaging 7.2 points and 4.6 rebounds per game. In his sophomore year, Kabengele led the team in scoring with 13.2 points per game along with 5.9 rebounds and 1.5 blocks per game despite not starting a single contest. He was named [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] Sixth Man of the Year. During the NCAA Tournament, Kabengele averaged 17.0 points, 8.0 rebounds, and 2.0 blocks per game.{{cite magazine |last1=Chorpenning |first1=Garrett |title=Mfiondu Kabengele wants to be the next great G League success story |url=https://www.si.com/nba/clippers/news/la-clippers-mfiondu-kabengele-g-league-success-story |accessdate=March 5, 2020 |magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]] |date=March 4, 2020}} On April 9, 2019, he declared for the NBA draft, thus forgoing his remaining two years of collegiate eligibility.{{cite news |last1=Weiler |first1=Curt |title=Florida State's Mfiondu Kabengele declares for NBA Draft, will sign with agent |url=https://www.tallahassee.com/story/sports/college/fsu/mensbasketball/2019/04/09/fsus-mfiondu-kabengele-declares-nba-draft-sign-agent/3417695002/ |accessdate=June 25, 2019 |work=[[Tallahassee Democrat]] |date=April 9, 2019}} ==Professional career== ===Los Angeles Clippers (2019–2021)=== On June 20, 2019, Kabengele was selected by the [[Brooklyn Nets]] with the 27th pick of the [[2019 NBA draft]], and his draft right was later traded to the [[Los Angeles Clippers]] in exchange for a future first-round pick in the 2020 NBA draft and the draft rights to the 56th pick of the 2019 NBA draft, [[Jaylen Hands]].{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/clippers/la-clippers-acquire-draft-rights-mfiondu-kabengele|title=L.A. Clippers Acquire Draft Rights to Mfiondu Kabengele|work=NBA.com|date=June 20, 2019|accessdate=June 25, 2019}} On July 9, 2019, the Clippers announced that they had signed Kabengele.{{cite web|title=L.A. Clippers Sign Kabengele and Mann|url=https://www.nba.com/clippers/rookie-signing-prep|date=July 9, 2019|website=NBA.com|accessdate=July 9, 2019}} On October 24, 2019, Kabengele made his debut in NBA, coming off the bench in a 141–122 win over the [[Golden State Warriors]] with three points, a rebound and a block.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401160658|title=Now with Clippers, Kawhi Leonard spoils Warriors fun again|date=October 24, 2019|website=ESPN.com|accessdate=October 24, 2019}} On November 16, 2019, Kabengele recorded 10 points and two rebounds in a 150–101 blowout win against the [[Atlanta Hawks]].{{cite web|url=https://www.fantasypros.com/nba/news/237829/mfiondu-kabengele-scores-10-eight-minutes.php|title=Mfiondu Kabengele scored 10 points in eight minutes|date=November 17, 2020|website=FantasyPros.com|accessdate=March 2, 2020}} Kabengele posted 25 points, 12 rebounds, three assists, three blocks and two steals on assignment for the G League's [[Agua Caliente Clippers]] in a 112–102 loss to the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]] on January 14, 2020.{{cite news |title=Clippers' Mfiondu Kabengele: Double-double for G League club |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/clippers-mfiondu-kabengele-double-double-for-g-league-club/ |accessdate=January 16, 2020 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=January 15, 2020}} He recorded 38 points, 12 rebounds, and a block on January 19 in a G League win over the [[Stockton Kings]].{{cite news |title=Clippers' Mfiondu Kabengele: Massive effort powers G League win |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/clippers-mfiondu-kabengele-massive-effort-powers-g-league-win/ |accessdate=January 21, 2020 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=January 20, 2020}} He worked to establish a three-point shot from the professional distance, in the G League. On March 22, 2021, Kabengele, along with a 2022 second-round pick belonging to the Atlanta Hawks, was traded to the [[Sacramento Kings]] for the Kings' 2022 second-round pick.{{cite web |title=LA Clippers Send Kabengele To Sacramento |url=https://www.nba.com/clippers/news/la-clippers-send-kabengele-sacramento |website=NBA.com |access-date=March 23, 2021 |date=March 22, 2021}} Three days later, he was waived.{{cite web|title=Kings Acquire Terence Davis|url=https://www.nba.com/kings/news/kings-acquire-terence-davis|date=March 25, 2021|website=NBA.com|accessdate=March 25, 2021}} ===Cleveland Cavaliers (2021)=== [[File:Mfiondu Kabengele 2021.jpg|thumb|right|Kabengele with the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] in 2021]] On April 10, 2021, Kabengele signed a 10-day contract with the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]].{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Sign Mfiondu Kabengele to 10-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases-kabengele-10-day-210410|website=NBA.com|date=April 10, 2021|access-date=April 10, 2021}} On April 21, he signed a second 10-day contract.{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Sign Mfiondu Kabengele to Second Ten-Day Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/kabengele-second-ten-day-210421|website=NBA.com|date=April 21, 2021|access-date=April 21, 2021}} On May 1, he signed a multi-year contract.{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Sign Mfiondu Kabengele to Multi-Year Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/kabengele-210501|website=NBA.com|date=May 1, 2021|access-date=May 1, 2021}}{{cite tweet|author=Adrian Wojnarowski|number=1388234319924236293|title=Cleveland Cavaliers F/C Mfiondu Kabengele is signing a deal for the rest of the season and non-guarantees on 2021-2022 and 2022-2023, sources tell ESPN.|user=wojespn|date=April 30, 2021|access-date=October 12, 2021}} On May 9, Kabengele logged a career-high 14 points on 5-of-7 shooting from the field and 1-of-2 from three, along with four rebounds and one assist across a career-high 23 minutes of play in a 124–97 loss to the [[Dallas Mavericks]].{{cite web|title=Cavaliers' Mfiondu Kabengele: Sets career highs in loss|url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/cavaliers-mfiondu-kabengele-sets-career-highs-in-loss/|website=CBSSports.com|date=May 9, 2021|access-date=May 11, 2021}}{{cite web|title=NBA 10, 2021|access-date=May 11, 2021}} On October 12, 2021, the Cleveland Cavaliers waived Kabengele.{{cite web|title=Cavaliers Waive Two Players|url=https://www.nba.com/cavaliers/releases/roster-update-211012|website=NBA.com|date=October 12, 2021|access-date=October 12, 2021}} ===Rio Grande Valley Vipers (2021–2022)=== On October 17, 2021, Kabengele signed with the [[Houston Rockets]], but was waived shortly thereafter.{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Rockets Claim Garrison Mathews, Waive Anthony Lamb|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2021/10/rockets-claim-garrison-mathews-waive-anthony-lamb.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 18, 2021|access-date=October 19, 2021}} He subsequently joined the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]] of the [[NBA G League]].{{cite web |last1=Merk |first1=Carson |title=Mfiondu Kabengele welcomes knowledge and evolution as a modern-day big man |url=https://riograndevalley.gleague.nba.com/news/mfiondu-kabengele-welcomes-knowledge-and-evolution-as-a-modern-day-big-man/ |website=NBA.com |access-date=February 6, 2022 |date=November 23, 2021}} ===Boston Celtics (2022–2023)=== On July 16, 2022, Kabengele signed a two-way contract with the [[Boston Celtics]] after an impressive showing during Summer League Play.{{cite web|title=Celtics Sign Kabengele|url=https://www.nba.com/celtics/news/pressrelease/celtics-sign-kabengele|website=NBA.com|date=July 16, 2022|access-date=July 16, 2022}} On March 27, 2023, he was named the G League Player of the Week after averaging 27 points, 16.5 rebounds and 2.0 assists.{{cite news |title=Mfiondu Kabengele Named G League Player Of The Week |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/wiretap/270936/Mfiondu-Kabengele-Named-G-League-Player-Of-The-Week |work=basketball.realgm.com |date=March 27, 2023}} On April 13, Kabengele was named to the All-NBA G League Second Team and the NBA G League All-Defensive Team.{{cite news |title=Kabengele, Samanic Rack Up League Awards |url=https://maine.gleague.nba.com/news/all-g-league-041323 |work=Maine Celtics |date=April 13, 2023 |language=en}} ===AEK Athens (2023)=== On August 13, 2023, Kabengele signed with [[AEK B.C.|AEK Athens]] of the [[Greek Basket League]], his first European club.{{cite web|title=Ο Καμπενγκέλε στη "Βασίλισσα"|url=https://www.aekbc.gr/o-kabengkele-sti-vasilissa/|website=AEKBC.gr|date=August 13, 2023|access-date=August 13, 2023|language=Greek}} On November 25, 2023, Kabengele recorded a monstrous statsheet of 30 points, 16 rebounds, 3 assists, 3 steals and 2 blocks in a 90–70 blowout win over rivals [[PAOK B.C.|PAOK]]. On December 26, 2023, his contract with [[AEK B.C.|AEK]] was terminated.{{cite web |title=Τέλος ο Καμπενγκέλε από την ΑΕΚ! |url=https://www.sport-fm.gr/article/basket/greece/aek-telos-o-kampengkele/4953687 |website=sport-fm.gr |access-date=26 December 2023 |location=Online |language=el}} He averaged 14 points, 8 rebounds and 1.2 blocks per game in domestic competition, as well as 10.5 points, 6.3 rebounds and 1.5 blocks in the [[Basketball Champions League|BCL]]. ===Reyer Venezia (2023–2025)=== After his contract with AEK was terminated, Kabengele signed with Italian side [[Reyer Venezia]]. Initially he was signed until the end of the 2023–2024 season, and was later re-signed for the 2024-2025 campaign.{{cite web |title= Venezia keeps Kabengele for another season|url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Italy/news/881528/Venezia-keeps-Kabengele-for-another-season |website=eurobasket.com|access-date=25 September 2024|location=Online |language=en}} ===Dubai Basketball (2025–present)=== On May 29, 2025, Kabengele signed with [[Dubai Basketball]] of the [[ABA League]] and [[EuroLeague]].{{Cite web|title=Mfiondu Kabengele (ex Venezia) signs at Dubai|url=https://www.eurobasket.com/ABA-League/news/935487/Mfiondu-Kabengele-ex-Venezia-signs-at-Dubai|access-date=July 17, 2025|website=eurobasket.com|language=en}} In 68 appearances for the team, he averaged 13.9 points, 6.1 rebounds, and 1.3 assists.
